name: Intersection-Free Dual Contouring
definition: An intersection-free variant of dual contouring that avoids self-intersecting triangles by using non-intersecting tests and tessellation, as opposed to the original algorithm which may produce self-intersections.
summary: Intersection-Free Dual Contouring generates manifold triangle meshes by detecting and resolving self-intersections via pairwise tests and local tessellation, unlike methods that modify optimization constraints.
